सिद्ध (द्धः) 1.
m. A demigod; saint;
inspired writer; an adept; a ma-
gician; an ascetic.
a. Accom-
plished; perfect; liberated;
eternal; celebrated; settled;
proved; cooked, prepared. 1.
f.
A medicinal root.
n. Sea salt.

सिद्ध-गङ्गा (ङ्गा) 1.
f. The Ganges of
heaven.

सिद्ध-जल (लं) 1.
n. Sour rice-gruel.

m. Shiva.

सिद्ध-धातु (तुः) 2.

m. Idem; An alchy-
mist.

सिद्ध-सङ्घ (ङ्घः) 1.
m. Company of
Siddhas.

सिद्ध-समस्तार्थ (र्थः-र्था-र्थं)

सिद्ध-सलिल (लं) 1.
n. Sour rice-gruel.

सिद्ध-साधन (नः) 1.
m. White mus-
tard.

rites, or things for that purpose.

सिद्ध-साध्य (ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)

proved.
n. Demonstration.

सिद्ध-सेन (नः) 1.
m. Kārtikeya.

सिद्धा-न्त (न्तः) 1.
m. Demonstrated
conclusion; established truth.

सिद्धान्तिन् (न्ती) 5.
m. A follower of
the
Mimāngsā philosophy.

सिद्धा-पगा (गा) 1.
f. The Ganges.

सिद्धायिका (का) 1.
f. One of the tu-
telary goddesses of the
Jaina.

सिद्धा-र्थ (र्थः) 1.
m. A
Jaina; Buddha;
white mustard. 1.
f. Mother of
the 4th
Jaina. a. Successful.

सिद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Fulfilment, com-
pletion; perfection; final bliss;
success; knowledge; correct-
ness; payment; concealment;
perfection in magic; magic
shoe; 16th
yoga.

सिद्धिली (ली) 3.
f. A small ant.
